facts.note: When the temple struck nine, the husband had everyone show their watches; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine and Aurèle scolded him for it.
She and the doctor played piquet in the salon without a break; the temple struck ten during play; he left to fetch cigars and she did not look at the clock when he went.

The transcript places his request to play before he went out ("Before he went out, did he say anything to you?" / "He asked me to play for him"), whereas the fact sheet says he asked as he went out. The rest (sat at piano at once, played until he came back, stopped when he came in) matches.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
